data.name: Aabidat
data.gender_notes: Aabidat is used as a unisex name in islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From Arabic ʿābidāt (عابدات), the feminine plural of ʿābid 'worshipper', from the root ʿ-b-d (worship, service). Aabidat therefore means “Worshippers; female devotees (of God)”. Arabic feminine plural ʿābidāt 'worshippers (f.)'; from the root ʿ-b-d.
data.spiritual_meaning: Aabidat expresses “Servant”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From Arabic ʿābidāt (عابدات), the feminine plural of ʿābid 'worshipper', from the root ʿ-b-d (worship, service).
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Aabidat total 20, reducing to 2. Number 2 is associated with cooperation, sensitivity and balance.

faq.a: Aabidat (عابدات) is the feminine plural of ʿābid 'worshipper', so it literally means 'female worshippers'. It is used as a girl's name in Muslim communities.

faq.q: What does the name Aabidat mean?
Where does the name Aabidat come from?
What is the linguistic root of Aabidat?
faq.a: The root of Aabidat is ع-ب-د (ʿ-b-d).

faq.q: How is Aabidat written in Arabic script?
faq.a: Aabidat is written عابدات in Arabic script.

faq.q: Is Aabidat a boy's or a girl's name?
faq.a: Aabidat is used as a female name.

faq.q: Does Aabidat appear in the Qur'an?
faq.a: No. Aabidat is not a Qur'anic name; it is used in Muslim naming tradition.

faq.q: Is the meaning of Aabidat verified?
faq.a: Yes — the meaning “Worshippers; female devotees (of God)” is established by Arabic feminine plural ʿābidāt 'worshippers (f.)'; from the root ʿ-b-d..
